title: cucurbita pepo var. subverrucosa
intro: Cucurbita pepo var. subverrucosa, commonly known as the ornamental gourd, is a variety of the Cucurbita pepo species, characterized by its unique, warted appearance. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been used to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with conditions such as arthritis and high blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Cucurbita pepo var. subverrucosa include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. Its bioactive constituents include cucurbitacins, flavonoids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
